title: 第十一章 激斗
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
三天了，自从杀死那个张家少主之后，已经三天了，他一直都在森林之中逃窜，他离开那个峭壁之后没过多久，就发现，有人在追杀他，几次都差点被追上。
叶希文暗忖，这次恐怕真的是杀了什么大人物了，不然的话，也不至于追了三天三夜了，而且似乎张家得到消息的人越来越多。
但是叶希文也不后悔，男子汉大丈夫做了就做了，毕竟张家的那个少主欺人太甚！
突然一阵脚步声从身后传来，叶希文顿时一跃而起，飞掠到一片茂密的树枝中，掩住了身形。
不一会儿，一行两人已经到了刚才叶希文的位置，一高一矮，两个身着张家服饰的武者。
“怎么脚印到这里没了，刚才还有的！”那个高瘦的武者说道。
“不管怎么样，一定要追到，这次家主震怒，一定要将凶手抓住，只要抓住了那个凶手，我们出人头地就不远了！”那矮胖的武者说道。
“死吧！”那个高手的武者顿时抽出一掌拍出，身形似箭，朝着上方就是激射而去。
原来刚才他们早就发现了自己，说那些话都是要让自己放松罢了。
叶希文顿时暗道，自己还是太过大意了，果然经验还是太少了，脚印到这里消失了，就被他们发现了。
之前是为了麻痹自己，就是为了现在的突袭，如果不是叶希文一直保持警惕，只怕刚才的突袭就能让叶希文重伤。
叶希文一手探出，噼里啪啦的一阵雷暴声，八响！
叶希文一上来就用上了全力，事到如今，他不敢有任何的大意，一掌按了下去。
“卡拉！”只听一声卡拉声，这个瘦高的武者顿时手臂被叶希文直接拍的骨折了，这个后天五重巅峰的武者怎么可能拦得住已经有了五虎之力的叶希文，更何况，还是威力全开的八响奔雷手。
那个瘦高的武者惨叫着跌落了下去。
叶希文在粗壮的树枝上一踏，顿时身形如箭，朝着那个跌落下去的瘦高的武者追了下去。
“嘭！”叶希文追了上去，奔雷手狠狠的轰在了那个瘦高武者的身上。
那个瘦高的武者惨叫一声被叶希文拍的血肉模糊！
一招毙命！
“小子，你找死！”那个矮胖的武者见同伴居然被叶希文直接拍死，顿时大怒，一拳轰出，掀起的气劲如利箭一般只朝着叶希文激射而去。

“嘭！”叶希文直接捏散了那个矮胖的武者打来的拳劲，顿时欺身上前，一掌拍出，伴随着轰隆隆的雷暴声。
那个矮胖的武者顿时惊慌的抬手一挡，毫无例外，直接被叶希文一掌拍断了手臂，顿时惨叫一声，身子往地上一滚，居然直接转身逃走。
事到如今，他如何还看不明白，叶希文绝对不是目前的他可以对付的了的。
不过叶希文如何会让对方逃走，一只手探出，轰隆隆，一阵雷暴声。
叶希文动作快如闪电，瞬间拍到了那个矮胖的武者的背上。
“噗！”那个矮胖的武者一口鲜血喷出，夹杂着内脏，五脏六腑都被叶希文一掌拍碎，一口喷了出来。
“轰！”那个矮胖的武者肥胖的身躯往前走了两步，就轰然倒地。
叶希文松了一口气，下次绝对不能大意了。
“小子，你好大的胆子，居然敢杀我张家的人！”这时候一道人影出现在了树枝之上，叶希文抬头一看，又是一个二十岁上下，面貌俊朗的黑衣青年。
“是你们先要杀我，我只是反击而已！”叶希文道。
“哼，狡辩，就算是我张家的人要杀你，你也要乖乖束手就擒！”那个黑衣青年霸道的说道。
“好霸道！”叶希文冷笑说道。
“霸道，就是霸道，你能奈我何！”那黑衣青年猖狂的大笑一声，一股强大的气势释放了出来，直接扫倒了无数的树枝，居然是后天六重后期。
那黑衣青年手掌一翻，宁掌成刀，真气直接喷射出来，凝聚成一把长刀的样子，一刀斩出，刀气纵横。
叶希文顿时大骇，要知道，凝聚真气成兵器，那是先天境界才有的威能，先天高手凝气成罡，就是罡兵，甚至比一般的兵器都要厉害，其中厉害的甚至能比拟神兵利器。
刀气扑面而来，叶希文不敢直接接下，虽然他手上没刀，但是这刀气却是切切实实的。
叶希文大喝一身，一掌拍出一团雷状真气，迎了上去。

content_en:
It had been three days since he killed the young master of the Zhang family. He had been fleeing in the forest. Not long after he left the cliff, he discovered that someone was chasing him, and he almost caught up with him several times.
Ye Xiwen secretly thought that he might have really killed some big shot this time, otherwise, he wouldn't have been chasing for three days and three nights, and it seemed that more and more people in the Zhang family were getting the news.
But Ye Xiwen didn't regret it. He just did what a man did. After all, the young master of the Zhang family was too bullying!
Suddenly a burst of footsteps came from behind, and Ye Xiwen immediately jumped up and flew into a dense branch, covering his figure.
After a while, the group of two people had arrived at Ye Xiwen's position just now, one tall and one short, two warriors wearing Zhang family clothes.
"Why are the footprints gone here? There were still ones just now!" said the tall and thin warrior.
"No matter what, we must catch up. This time the master of the house is furious and must catch the murderer. As long as we catch the murderer, we will not be far away from becoming famous!" said the short and fat warrior.
"Die!" The master warrior immediately took out a palm and shot it upward like an arrow.
It turns out that they had discovered themselves just now, and they were just saying those words to relax themselves.
Ye Xiwen suddenly thought to himself that he was still too careless. Sure enough, he still had too little experience. The footprints disappeared at this point and were discovered by them.
It was to paralyze himself before, just for the current raid. If Ye Xiwen hadn't been vigilant all the time, I was afraid that the raid just now would have seriously injured Ye Xiwen.
Ye Xiwen stretched out his hand, and there was a burst of crackling thunderstorms, eight blasts!
Ye Xiwen used all his strength as soon as he came up. At this point, he didn't dare to be careless and pressed down with his palm.
"Kara!" Just hearing a karaoke sound, the tall and thin warrior's arm was immediately broken by Ye Xiwen's direct hit. How could this warrior who was at the fifth level of acquired power stop Ye Xiwen who already had the power of the five tigers? What's more, he was still the eight-ring thunder hand at full power.
The tall and thin warrior screamed and fell down.
Ye Xiwen stepped on the thick branch, and suddenly he was like an arrow, chasing the tall and thin warrior who fell.
"Bang!" Ye Xiwen chased after him and hit the tall and thin warrior with his thunderous hand.
The tall and thin warrior screamed and was beaten to pieces by Ye Xiwen!
Kill with one move!
"Boy, you are looking for death!" The short and fat warrior saw that his companion was actually beaten to death by Ye Xiwen. He was furious and punched out, and the energy he raised was like a sharp arrow and shot towards Ye Xiwen.
"Bang!" Ye Xiwen directly crushed the punch from the short and fat warrior, stepped forward and struck out with a palm, accompanied by a rumbling thunderstorm.
The short and fat warrior immediately raised his hand in panic to block it. Without exception, his arm was broken off by Ye Xiwen's palm. He screamed, rolled to the ground, and actually turned around and ran away.
Until now, he still couldn't understand that Ye Xiwen was definitely not someone he could deal with now.
But how could Ye Xiwen let the other party escape? He stretched out a hand and heard a thunderstorm.
Ye Xiwen's movements were as fast as lightning, and he instantly photographed the short and fat warrior on the back.
"Poof!" The short and fat warrior spurted out a mouthful of blood, mixed with his internal organs. All the internal organs were smashed by Ye Xiwen's palm and spurted out in one mouthful.
"Boom!" The fat body of the short, fat warrior took two steps forward before falling to the ground.
Ye Xiwen breathed a sigh of relief and must not be careless next time.
"Boy, you are so brave, you dare to kill a member of my Zhang family!" At this time, a figure appeared on the branch. Ye Xiwen looked up and saw another young man in black, about twenty years old, with a handsome face.
"You wanted to kill me first, IJust fight back! "Ye Xiwen said.
"Huh, sophistry, even if someone from my Zhang family wants to kill you, you have to surrender without mercy! "The young man in black said domineeringly.
"So domineering! Ye Xiwen said with a sneer.
"Domineering is just domineering, what can you do to me! "The young man in black laughed wildly, and a powerful momentum was released, directly sweeping down countless branches. He was actually at the late sixth level of the day after tomorrow.
The young man in black flipped his palm and turned his palm into a sword. His true energy spurted out directly, condensing into the shape of a long sword, and slashed out with the sword energy in all directions.
Ye Xiwen was immediately horrified. You must know that condensing the true energy into a weapon is a power that only exists in the innate realm. An innate master can condense the energy into a steel weapon, which is a steel weapon. It is even more powerful than ordinary weapons, and the powerful ones can even be compared to divine weapons.
The sword energy rushed towards his face, and Ye Xiwen did not dare to take it directly. Although he did not have a knife in his hand, the sword energy was real.
Ye Xiwen shouted loudly, shot out a ball of thunder-like Qi with one palm, and rushed forward.
